name: Patterson-UTI Energy
outlook:
What Patterson-UTI Energy says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: Drilling Services adjusted gross profitOverall, we expect Drilling Services adjusted gross profit of $150 million in the fourth quarter.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: Completion Services gross profitIn Completion Services, we expect fourth quarter adjusted gross profit of $140 million, supported by activity levels broadly consistent with the third quarter and additional pricing improvements.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: Drilling Products adjusted gross profitIn Drilling Products, we expect fourth quarter adjusted gross profit to decline 5-10%, sequentially, primarily reflecting the expectation for lower drilling activity in Saudi Arabia due to ongoing geopolitical unrest in the region.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: administrative and DD&A expenseFor the fourth quarter, we expect general and administrative expense to be approximately $70 million and depreciation, depletion, amortization, and impairment expense to be approximately $220 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
